logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_SOURCE_FILE_ARCHIVED", runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, processingSourceFilePath: vars.processingSourceFilePath, archiveSourceFilePath: (vars.archiveDirectory default "archive") ++ "/" ++ (vars.expectedSourceFileName default "UNKNOWN_FILE"), archivedAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

logger.doc:name: Log Source Archive Failure
